newsitem.title: ISRAEL: Bank Hapoalim notes rated A3 by Moody's.
newsitem.headline: Bank Hapoalim notes rated A3 by Moody's.

text.p: Moody's Investors Service has assigned an A3 rating to a recently issued floating rate note issue by Hapoalim International NV, Hapoalim's parent, Bank Hapoalim, said on Sunday.

The bank said the A3 rating is the same assigned to Bank Hapoalim and to long-term debt issued by the Israeli government. Hapoalim said it marked the first time Moody's had rated an offering of an Israeli bank.
The rating applies to $200 million in notes being offered in stages on the London Stock Exchange. More than $100 million has been offered this month, twice what the bank said it expected to issue.
Final redemption for the notes is July 2006, with an early redemption option in 2002.
